text:
Maria: Heads up — models-prod in eu-west-1 started failing to call control plane ~10:10 UTC. Clients hit timeouts talking to our VPCE endpoint. @ops-oncall
infra-bot: [ALERT] vpce-0abc1234 in eu-west-1 shows NLB target failures and ENI flapping (10:12)
Ken: What do the logs show? short snippet?
Maria: From model-host logs: "tls handshake timeout" then "connection reset by peer". Tried `curl https://vpce.service.internal` -> times out.
Sam: Any recent infra changes? terraform apply, SG edits, or subnet updates?
Maria: No TF changes in the last 24h in git. But I ran a quick ENI check:
```
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=description,Values="*vpce-0abc1234*" --query '[NetworkInterfaces[].{Subnet:SubnetId,AZ:AvailabilityZone,Status:Status}'
```
Only ENIs in eu-west-1a showed up — nothing in 1b/1c. That explains partial reachability and repeated NLB healthfail.
Ken: If the endpoint has no ENIs in some AZs traffic can land on unhealthy NLB nodes -> blackhole. Any chance the endpoint associations to subnets were accidentally removed?
Maria: I checked `describe-vpc-endpoints` -> SubnetIds list missing 1b. Not sure how it drifted.
Sam: Also check NACLs on the subnets for ephemeral ports. Interface endpoints and NLB healthchecks need ephemeral ranges open.
Maria: Good call. NACL on 1b had an explicit DENY for ephemeral range (1024-65535) from a prior lockdown change. That would block healthchecks coming from the NLB and remote service checks.
ops-oncall: I'm going to re-associate the missing subnet with the VPCE and open the ephemeral range on the NACL. Doing one change at a time and monitoring.
ops-oncall: Re-associated subnet eu-west-1b -> vpce-0abc1234 (10:27).
ops-oncall: Updated NACL on eu-west-1b to allow ephemeral 1024-65535 (10:31).
infra-bot: [INFO] NLB target group health checks returning healthy for vpce-0abc1234 (10:35)
Maria: Retested from a model pod: `curl https://vpce.service.internal` -> 200 OK now. Services recovered. :thumbsup:
Ken: Nice. Root cause seems to be twofold: endpoint subnet disassociation (drift) + NACL blocking ephemeral ports. Both required to cause this partial outage.
Sam: Action items: 1) Add tf guardrails to prevent subnet removal from VPCE resources. 2) Add automated check for ENI counts per VPCE (expected AZ count). 3) Add NACL policy check ensuring ephemeral ranges allowed for endpoint subnets.
Maria: I'll open the TF PR for guardrail and add a runbook note about NACLs and VPCE healthchecks.
ops-oncall: Also putting a short alert into infra-monitoring: if ENI count < expected for any VPCE -> page.
Ken: Thanks all. Moving to postmortem template and mark as Sev3.
Maria: filing the postmortem now with timeline and commands used.
